title: ixora javanica var. tidorensis
intro: Ixora javanica var. tidorensis, commonly known as Tidorea, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical regions. The health benefits of Tidorea include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Tidorea is also reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Tidorea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
